title: Emergency/medical glossary, 1 language pair (register/gender)
context: Consistent, register- and gender-correct terminology is essential for safe emergency translation, so each language pair gets a controlled glossary of emergency/medical terms. A qualified reviewer is required because incorrect medical terminology can cause harm. This first glossary covers one language pair and depends on the source allow-list.
objective: Author an emergency/medical glossary for one language pair with register and gender handling.
acceptanceCriteria: glossaries/<src>-<tgt>.yaml has >= 25 terms, each with term, translation or preserve, partOfSpeech, register, genderForms (where applicable), and notes
Terminology is reviewed and signed off by a qualified speaker of the target language
Sources for any derived terms are recorded against the allow-list; no uncleared sources used
Validates against glossarySchema and passes CI structural checks
